name: artifact
description: Create or edit deliverable files in the WebUI Artifact workspace with a patch (*** Begin Patch / *** End Patch). Paths are plain artifact file names. Use it for reports, documents and standalone files the user should look at, not for routine source edits; publish an existing local file with present_artifact and read entries with read using artifact: paths. HTML runs in a sandboxed frame with no network: external CDNs, fetch and remote images are blocked, but ECharts at /vendor/echarts/echarts.min.js, KaTeX at /vendor/katex/katex.min.js and Prism at /vendor/prism/prism.min.js work.

patchText.description: Full patch text wrapped in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch.
